results.name: Fresh state is independent, serializable and has the intended small encounter
Ready and paused states freeze movement, combat, reload and elapsed time
Sprint collision stops before thin cover and diagonal input slides alongside it
Diagonal movement is normalized and crouching changes speed and eye height
Nearest cover blocks rifle shots and LOS; visible targets take two hits
Shooting removes only the destructible cover and opens movement plus visibility
Reload and fire cooldown cannot create ammunition or permit firing early
Terrain blocks a shot into the bluff and rays choose the nearest defender
Cover protects the crouching player from enemy fire
Authored ally route is traversable and allies eventually reach the objective
Mission requires both defenders; a scripted movement-and-shooting run can win
A longer western flank also reaches both defenders and wins under live fire
